ranking_rule: Platforms are ranked for Mahmoud Salama's senior technology and consulting profile.

platforms.title: Fiverr
platforms.headline: Enterprise Technology & Digital Transformation Consultant
platforms.summary: Best used by packaging your expertise into clearly scoped consulting services rather than bidding on conventional job vacancies.
best_for: Power BI, data-platform and executive-dashboard advisory
routes: Business, data, AI and technology consulting categories.
strategy: Create premium fixed-scope offers instead of low-cost generic gigs.
Use your executive portfolio and quantified national-scale outcomes as proof.
Offer discovery calls, architecture reviews and written executive deliverables.
Avoid services that require continuous low-rate development or support.
platforms.cautions: Fiverr is seller-led. Success depends on service packaging, reviews, positioning and response speed.

platforms.title: Freelancer.com
platforms.headline: Enterprise Architect, Technology Program Manager & Digital Transformation Consultant
platforms.summary: Useful for project-based consulting, cloud, architecture, program-management and enterprise-system engagements, but proposals must be filtered carefully to avoid low-value work.
best_for: Power BI, reporting and data-platform projects
Technical documentation, governance and operating-model work
routes: Keyword search for IT project-management work.
strategy: Bid only on verified clients with clear scope, budget and payment history.
Lead with enterprise architecture, healthcare technology and national-scale delivery.
Use milestone-based proposals and define assumptions before accepting work.
Prefer consulting and management assignments over commodity development tasks.
platforms.cautions: Open bidding creates strong price competition. Confirm scope, client verification and milestone funding.

platforms.title: Upwork
platforms.headline: Enterprise Architecture, Healthcare Technology & Digital Transformation Consultant
platforms.summary: The strongest general freelance platform for your profile because it supports senior consulting, technology strategy, software consulting, program management and long-term client engagements.
best_for: Data, BI, governance and transformation projects
strategy: Build a specialised profile around enterprise systems and healthcare transformation.
Use targeted proposals that reference the client's architecture, governance or delivery problem.
Pursue expert-level and long-term contracts rather than high-volume small tasks.
Show your executive portfolio, architecture outcomes and public-sector scale.
platforms.cautions: Connects and platform competition make indiscriminate proposals expensive. Apply selectively.

platforms.title: Toptal
platforms.headline: Technology Executive, Enterprise Architect & Technical Project Manager
platforms.summary: A premium target for senior consulting and project-management work. The selection process is demanding, but your 18+ years and enterprise-scale portfolio support a credible application.
routes: Apply as a project manager, management consultant or technology expert.
strategy: Prepare architecture, delivery-governance and stakeholder scenarios for screening.
Apply under the category closest to your strongest evidence: project management or consulting.
Use concise, quantified examples from MediQ, national data platforms and government transformation.
Be ready for English communication and detailed technical or case interviews.
platforms.cautions: Admission is selective and category-specific. Do not claim platform-specific expertise you cannot demonstrate.

platforms.title: Contra
platforms.headline: Enterprise Technology Consultant & Digital Transformation Advisor
platforms.summary: Strong for portfolio-led independent consulting, global project discovery, professional visibility, contracts and commission-free payments.
best_for: Independent studio or consulting practice positioning
strategy: Build a portfolio-first profile using your executive case studies.
Position services around architecture assessments and transformation roadmaps.
Request recommendations from previous stakeholders where appropriate.
Use Contra for direct clients and structured contracts, not only job-feed applications.
platforms.cautions: Some opportunity access and advanced visibility features may require a paid plan.

platforms.title: PeoplePerHour
platforms.headline: Technology Strategy, Architecture & Project Delivery Consultant
platforms.summary: A secondary source for consulting, software, IT and project-management assignments. Suitable opportunities exist, but average project sizes may be below your target level.
strategy: Use high-value offers and hourly consulting rather than small fixed-price tasks.
Set clear boundaries around deliverables and response time.
Target clients needing architecture, integration or transformation planning.
Link to your executive portfolio in every relevant proposal.
platforms.cautions: Use careful budget filtering and avoid competing for low-value commodity tasks.

platforms.title: Guru
platforms.headline: Enterprise Systems, Cloud & Program Management Consultant
platforms.summary: Useful as a secondary project source for technology, cloud, software, operations and project-management work.
strategy: Search by exact enterprise, cloud and project-management keywords.
Review employer payment verification and historical spend.
Use SafePay or funded milestones.
Focus on complex advisory assignments with fewer competing quotes.
platforms.cautions: Client quality and project depth vary. Verify payment, scope and employer history.

platforms.title: FlexJobs
platforms.model: Curated remote and flexible job board
platforms.headline: Senior Technology, Architecture & Digital Transformation Leader
platforms.summary: A strong source for remote full-time, freelance, flexible and director-level technology roles, especially when you need curated remote listings.
best_for: Data, software and technical program management
strategy: Set career level to manager, director or executive.
Use remote-location filters that accept Egypt or worldwide applicants.
Prioritise employer-direct listings and confirm work-authorisation restrictions.
Search both permanent and freelance categories.
platforms.cautions: Some features require membership. A remote label does not always mean worldwide eligibility.

platforms.title: Wellfound
platforms.headline: CTO, Enterprise Architect & Digital Platform Leader
platforms.summary: A high-priority source for startup CTO, Head of Technology, engineering-management, product, data, cloud and architecture roles with salary and equity visibility.
best_for: CTO and Head of Technology roles
strategy: Set preferences for CTO, technology leadership, architecture and remote work.
Use your portfolio to show products, platforms and measurable outcomes.
Assess startup stage, funding, salary, equity and founder credibility.
Avoid equity-only roles unless the business and governance are independently verified.
platforms.cautions: Many roles are geography-restricted or equity-heavy. Review funding, runway and compensation carefully.

platforms.title: We Work Remotely
platforms.headline: Remote Technology, Product & Program Leader
platforms.summary: A strong remote board for technical program management, product, DevOps, infrastructure, software and management-consulting opportunities.
routes: Product leadership and technical product roles.
strategy: Check geographic eligibility before applying to 'remote' roles.
Use program manager, enterprise, architecture, product, DevOps and healthcare keywords.
Prioritise worldwide roles and direct employer listings.
Use job alerts and saved preferences for fresh listings.
platforms.cautions: Many remote vacancies remain country or time-zone restricted despite appearing on a global board.
